categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Zhenyu Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in precision progressive stamping molds and downstream precision structural parts. Its main product lines include high-end precision progressive stamping molds, motor iron cores, and precision structural parts for new energy lithium batteries. The company also extends into emerging fields such as humanoid robot precision components and assemblies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision progressive stamping mold technology with manufacturing accuracy reaching 0.002mm, employing CAD/CAM/CAE design, parallel technology, rapid prototyping, virtual manufacturing, and precision manufacturing techniques. Production involves complex multi-station stamping, CNC machining, heat treatment, laser welding, and automated assembly lines. It also develops proprietary technologies such as high-speed stamping, laser coding, friction welding, and advanced sealing and welding techniques for lithium battery components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international manufacturers in home appliances, new energy vehicles, industrial control, and humanoid robotics. Notable clients are CATL, BYD, Xiaomi, Nidec, and other top-tier electric motor and lithium battery producers. The company serves markets in automotive (including EVs), home appliances, industrial automation, and emerging sectors like humanoid robots and low-altitude economy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Ningbo, Suzhou, Taicang, Yibin, and other provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries in Hungary and Serbia and exports products to Europe, Japan, South Korea, and other international markets. Domestic sales account for over 98% of revenue, with a growing presence in overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Zhenyu Technology is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of precision molds and structural components that are critical inputs for downstream manufacturers of electric motors, lithium batteries, and robotics. It acts as a key supplier to OEMs and tier-1 suppliers in these industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment in high-precision mold technology, advanced stamping processes, and lithium battery structural innovations. It actively develops new materials, automated production lines, and novel welding and sealing technologies. Strategic R&D also targets emerging sectors such as humanoid robots and low-altitude electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) vehicles, aiming to become a comprehensive hardware solutions provider.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized precision progressive stamping molds and precision structural parts. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with sales directly to end customers without intermediaries. It also earns income from after-sales services and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in high-end precision progressive stamping molds, especially for electric motor iron cores, breaking foreign monopolies in this niche. It is recognized as a key backbone enterprise in the motor iron core mold industry by the China Mold Industry Association. It competes with other domestic and international mold and precision parts manufacturers, maintaining a strong market position through technological leadership and strategic partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.13 billion, an 18.45% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 254 million, a 493.77% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 11.43 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 2.99 billion. It has shown strong growth driven by expanding orders, enhanced automation, and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Zhenyu Technology offers high-precision, high-efficiency progressive stamping molds with international-level accuracy and reliability, enabling customers to improve product quality and production efficiency. Its integrated precision manufacturing system, strong R&D capabilities, and customized solutions provide competitive advantages. The company’s focus on innovation, quality control, and responsive after-sales service ensures stable, high-quality supply to leading customers in fast-growing industries such as new energy vehicles and robotics.
